title: Local Notes App
summary: A local notes app with create, list, title search, delete, a browser interface, and SQLite persistence. Reuse the reviewed Notes App starter.
features: Create notes with a title and body
Persist notes in SQLite across server restarts
Use all features through a browser interface
risks: Passing checks covers tested behavior only. Review generated code before running it locally.

tasks.title: Preserve and adapt the reviewed Notes App
tasks.instructions: Use the supplied reviewed starter. Keep its working server, SQLite initialization, asset routes, safe text rendering and CLI. Do not rebuild working infrastructure. POST /api/notes returns HTTP 201 and one object with id, title, body. List and search return arrays of these objects. DELETE /api/notes/{id} returns HTTP 200 with deleted true. Allow duplicate titles. Do not add timestamps. Keep create_server(host, port), /health, and the existing browser create/list/search/delete controls. Make only necessary changes; if the implementation already meets the scope, add a meaningful behavioral test instead of rewriting it.

tasks.title: Complete actual application tests
tasks.instructions: Keep test_foundation.py unchanged. Preserve the starter behavior tests and add any missing tests in a separate test file that imports the actual app. Verify create/list, case-insensitive matching and nonmatching search, delete, malformed input and safe text rendering. A real persistence test must create a note, stop and close the server, start a new server against the same temporary database, and retrieve that note before deletion. Preserve the existing process-restart test. Use temporary data, ephemeral ports, HTTP request timeouts and proper cleanup. Keep the app launchable with --host and --port. Do not claim execution; Foundry will run checks after separate execution approval.

checks.name: Read saved data before deletion; real restart is checked in unittest
